card.name: "Well" after shake or stir
card.fires_on: The word "well" right after a mixing verb such as shake or stir, in directions for preparing a liquid or powder.

modes.label: Shake well
modes.description: "Well" after "Shake" in reconstitution or bottle directions.
modes.example: Tap bottle to loosen powder, then add water in 2 portions. Shake<< well>> after each aliquot.

modes.label: Stir well
modes.description: "Well" after "Stir" when mixing a packet or tablet into water or juice.

card.plain: It marks the word "well" in mixing directions like "shake well" or "stir well".
